page.layout: One page of text, centred. Top: decorative ornament (not transcribed). Below it: a dedication address in centred, mostly capitalised lines, ending with the dedicatory sentence and the name of the dedicator. Below that: a decorative ornament band. Foot of page: a closing "D" at centre and the catchword "CAN-" at right. No margin notes. A library stamp at lower right is not transcribed.

page.notes: The scan is slightly rotated and some letters are worn; readings are from the image as displayed. "Basilien sibus" is printed with a space and is copied as printed. "Profesfori" in the Coccio line is copied as it appears on the scan. The top-right pencil numeral and the circular library stamp are not transcribed. The "D" at the foot is taken as the gathering signature and "CAN-" as the catchword.
